description:
We're building a practical, data-driven tool using NASA Earth observation datasets (soil moisture, precipitation, temperature) to provide actionable crop and climate insights for farmers. 

My background covers Python, backend APIs, data pipelines, and UI prototyping. Looking for teammates with frontend, UI/UX design, or data science/GIS skills, as well as anyone passionate about space data and pitch storytelling. Let’s collaborate and build an impactful project!
